programme.title: Political Thinking with Nick Robinson
programme.desc: Nick Robinson in conversation with people who influence our political thinking.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Kemah Bob, JJ Chalmers, Kevin Clifton and Victoria Derbyshire take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quick-fire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted by the House of Games kitchen composter?

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp hosts this quiz show with sidekick Sarah Greene where contestants race on moving podiums across the studio floor. Correct answers get the players moving, while wrong answers stop them in their tracks. Five contestants battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - make it to the finish line before your rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the £5,000 cash prize.

programme.title: Lightning
programme.desc: Comedian Zoe Lyons presents the electrifyingly fast quiz with a £3,000 jackpot. Six plucky contestants compete across six rounds testing their general knowledge, quick thinking and speedy reactions whilst our ruthless spotlight patrols the studio. The contestants’ motivation in each round is simple: stay out of the light and you’ll be all right!

programme.title: The Farmers' Country Showdown
programme.desc: Debbie and Paul may not come from farming backgrounds, but Debbie’s determination after quitting her office job means they are now the proud owners of 300 alpacas on their Northumberland farm. They are heading to the Westmorland County Show in Cumbria, hoping to return home with rosettes and maybe even the champion breed title, which they have won before. Meanwhile, Lancashire alpaca farmer Bev also faces the heat of competition, and a champion win would take her one step closer to fulfilling her dream of full-time farming in the future.

programme.title: The Hidden World of Hospitality with Tom Kerridge
programme.desc: The biggest celebrations in people's lives would be nothing without great hospitality operators working tirelessly behind the scenes. Tom looks at how the industry delivers exceptional service on a huge scale. In Wolverhampton, Tom meets the team behind Grand Station, a large events venue housed in a former railway station. In the Scottish village of Grandtully, the Highland Chocolatier supplies the trade with fine chocolates relied upon by the hospitality industry. And Tom has a huge catering event of his own: the Six Nations rugby match between England and France at Twickenham.

programme.title: Wild Brazil
programme.desc: This intimate journey into the heart of Brazil concludes. A fierce drought ensues, culminating in huge and ferocious fires. The capuchin monkeys, giant otters, coatis and jaguars are proving their extreme survival skills, while looking for mates and racing to breed to ensure that the next generation are born just as the good times arrive again. Astonishing footage tells an extraordinary tale of love in a harsh world.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin presents from Norwich Cathedral in Norfolk. In the great nave, experts Thomas Plant and David Fletcher pick out some choice items to take to auction. Among them are a masonic watch and a much sought-after commemorative mug by Eric Ravilious. Paul also visits the extravagant home of Britain's first prime minister, Robert Walpole.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, four previous players who came close to winning but never quite made it - Fern Britton, JB Gill, John Kearns and Sally Lindsay - take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. With their second chance at winning a prize, will they opt for the House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted with the very popular bee hotel?

programme.title: Just One Thing
programme.desc: In Edinburgh, 70-year-old Alister’s cycling accidents have resulted in a few knocks to his health and his confidence. Roman Kemp has a counterintuitive solution: easy exercise. It sounds backwards, but research shows that 'reverse' moves – like walking downhill instead of up, or lowering weights instead of lifting them – could deliver bigger gains in muscle strength, bone density and blood sugar control. Sometimes, the easy route really is the smart one.

programme.title: Grand Tours of Scotland's Lochs
programme.desc: Paul follows in the footsteps of Bonnie Prince Charlie exploring the lesser-known lochs along the west coast of Scotland. Landing at Glenuig, he makes his way inland to Loch Moidart and MacDonald country, walking the old coffin road, which was used for centuries by funeral parties, taking their dead to a sacred isle. On the track Paul meets a trials bike enthusiast and learns the secrets of a 'dabbing coat' before landing off the Green Isle where he rings a 1,100-year-old bell for the dead. Taking a boat north, Paul sails up Loch Shiel to Glenfinnan where Bonnie Prince Charlie officially began his rising to reclaim the throne for the Stuart dynasty. From a forgotten monument that commemorates this event, Paul heads back to the coast and Loch Ailort, where he learns how to knife fight before taking a trip across the loch to a deserted community on the roadless Ardnish peninsula.

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: It's all about the borders at Beechgrove Garden as Brian Cunningham and Kirsty Wilson replant, fill gaps and replace losses all around the plot. Kirsty revisits her hot border, designed to display vibrant colours at the height of summer. The winter temperatures killed off a few plants, so she will be trying out some alternatives. Brian is in the calendar border, created to have some form of colour or interest every month of the year. It has not had much attention this year, so Brian will be topping it up to ensure year-round performance. Kirsty will also be planting in the border behind Beechgrove's main pond, where other gaps have appeared, and she is building a new structure to create a habitat for pollinators. There is a trip to visit a great garden on the Cowal Peninsula, and all the week's handy hints.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: It’s the first ever RHS Sandringham Flower Show, and Arit Anderson, Jamie Butterworth and Frances Tophill are on hand to take a look around. From spectacular show gardens to a floral marquee packed full of horticultural goodies, there is something to whet the appetite. A local grower who knows everything there is to know about roses provides expert advice, while a National Collection holder in Lincolnshire shines a light on drought-tolerant achilleas. A couple in Kent share their new-found love of succulents, with some useful advice on how to care for them. And in Hampshire, a plantsman conveys his passion for carrying on the family tradition of running a nursery.

programme.title: So Awkward

programme.desc: Animated short film. Susan Murphy and the monsters are now working with the US government as special ops. So when an alien presence is detected in Susan's hometown of Modesto, California, right before Halloween, the team is dispatched to investigate.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee is cleaning out the workshop but it's a very big job and he needs the Squirrels' help. And once they're in, can they find the way out again?

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad’s accused of ‘fluffing’ in Bluey’s face, Mum calls a meeting to settle the matter

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: It is Bluey’s first trip to the cinema, but she’s worried that the movie will be too scary. When Bingo starts running amok in the theatre, she must conquer her fear and help Dad out.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: The Go Jetters join Ubercorn in the Go Jet Academy to try out a brand new click-on: the GO Vac, a supervacuum that can suck up bad weather. In order to put it to the test, Ubercorn creates a small hailstorm cloud inside the dome and Lars tries to suck it up with the GO Vac. However, Glitch appears and tries to show off his new 'Grim-o-Freeze' and zaps the cloud. Instead of disappearing, it grows in size and ferocity, breaking the roof with a smash. The sudden change in pressure blows everyone about inside the dome and the cloud blows outside, taking Glitch and the Grimbots with it. The Go Jetters need to catch it fast so launch their brand new vehicle, the Truckster.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Mr Tod's efforts to creep up on the rabbits are thwarted by a noisy song thrush, he cages the bird so that he can ambush Peter and his friends without warning.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Join an adventurous team of underwater explorers as they dive into action, rescuing all sorts of amazing sea creatures and trying their best to protect the ocean.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: One wonders if anyone could be bigger than One Hundred, and has a big think about some very big numbers indeed. Learn about huge numbers with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. From A to Z, every Alphablock has fun discovering the magic of wordplay. Young Y wants to know why he can't sing with the vowels - but anything's possible if you try...

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: After a lab mishap, Looph’s new ‘size-o-matic’ machine misfires, causing her to shrink. Can she find a clever way to alert her friends and turn everything back to normal?

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Boom is showing off but slips and has a mild panic. To hide his embarrassment, he challenges Zog to a dragon-off! Zog must set aside his desire to win and help his rival.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Farmer Jackson was just trying to grow some giant tomatoes, but he wound up with a giant pig! Now, Mojo and Bo have to get Felix back to normal size before Swoppiton gets stomped.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: 'Sula likes her easy peasy pasta one way and I like mine another way, but that's OK, you can eat it any way you like.' Bing and Sula help Amma to get lunch ready. Bing watches yummy peas and delicious carrots go into the pot, but when lunch is served they're all mixed up together and Bing doesn't like it. Amma finds Bing an unmixing spoon so that Bing can enjoy his lunch just the way he likes it.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘frog’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see green, brown, hopping and croaking frogs, and one with a really long tongue! Dee looks for a frog that’s hiding and then relaxes with a clam frog. The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee’s friend finally succeeds in saying today’s word.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Mum is taking Maddie and Triggs to McGinty’s farm to hear his world-famous animal orchestra. But McGinty’s star performer, Gary the Chicken, won’t come out of his coop! Can Maddie use her musical skills and expert diplomacy to save the day?

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Keith is on the way to his first music lesson with Brian, but a wild air stream blocks the path, sweeping everyone away! The Piggies must help him cross, but they can’t agree on which materials to use. Can they solve the problem before it’s too late?

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos watch a waiter set a wedding table in a marquee. The waiter places plates and cutlery next to each other. The Twirlywoos then decide to help out by getting items from outside and placing them next to the plates until there is an entire garden's worth of items on the table. The bride and groom enter and are amazed. Peekaboo has trouble with the Twirly Rings rolling around the Big Red Boat. When the Twirlywoos arrive, they jump down into the Big Red Boat, only to land next to each other inside the Twirly Rings!

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and his friend take a boat trip to spot some wildlife. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble creates a beach in his garden, but things don’t entirely go to plan.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Preschool series. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po do a roundy round dance and watch children in Tummy Tales ride a carousel which goes round and round too.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Nigel and Baby Bear welcome babies Amber, Amelia, Arthur, DJ, Zadie, Betsy, Indianna and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Inside everyone’s bags in this episode are Leaves which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding baby appropriate leaves inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The song ‘All the leaves are falling down’ features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Action Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children craft hanging stars from twigs and colourful string, learn British Sign Language signs for twinkle, star and world, then sing and sign Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star.

programme.title: I Can Grow It
programme.desc: Aaron, Nelly and Abbie follow Chatterpot’s slimy trail to discover how slugs and snails love to munch around in the garden and help keep the garden tidy and magical.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Bahati the zebra has an itch she just can’t scratch, so her friends try to help. Hamza discovers wild buffalo and visits some thirsty elephants.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Kiri decides to make Lou miss her, but it doesn’t go well.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In a game of 'Work', Dad hires Bluey and Bingo at his drainpipe factory. But when Bluey takes charge, Dad finds his new boss pretty tough, especially her no dancing rule.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: When Egg, the cheeky little chick, goes on the run again, Duggee whistles to get him back. Hang on a minute Duggee, what was that noise? A whistle? The Squirrels want to learn how to whistle.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: The Printing Crew come to the rescue and print signs for their friends Red, Blue and Green.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: George wants to find out all about prawns in today’s episode. Chantelle meets some new friends at the beach and heads to the rock pools to search for prawns, whilst Rory goes to the north of Scotland to meet a local expert at the harbour. Chantelle and Rory’s fact files help answer all of George’s questions. With the help of the Teeny Tiny Creatures poem, we discover that, like lots of other teeny tiny creatures, prawns are superheroes and help our planet in their own special way. In the Teeny Tiny Task, Chantelle and the children play at being prawns with a game of 'What’s the Time, Mr Fish?'

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Today, sisters Iona and Elba make their family’s famous shortbread biscuits and throw a picnic with teddy bears! Out in the park, they play at launching rockets into the sky. But when one of the rockets lands in a stream, will the brave astronauts be able to get it back?

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Children’s cookery series with Big Cook Jen and Little Cook Small. Jen is being an artist today and trying to paint a cheetah, but she has run out of paint for the spots. They are visited by Ada the Artist and cook her a delicious arty pancake.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Tinks is a disability assistance dog for her owner Charli, who has a condition that makes it painful for her to pick things up or to push and pull things. Tinks uses her super fetch skills to help Charli every day. The smallest of the Dog Squad gang, Tinks is a little Lhasa apso with lots of big dog energy. Charli is meeting her friend Annabel for lunch at the local café. They haven’t been out for a lunch treat for ages, and the café’s speciality is Tinks’s favourite – chicken. First, Charli parks her car using her blue parking badge and then gets her wheelchair out of the boot using a hoist. Tinks then helps Charli go into the café, find a table and go to the counter to order their lunch. But when the café owner sees Tinks, he tells Charli that they only allow in guide dogs and that Tinks will have to wait outside. Brave Tinks summons all her big dog energy to help Charli persuade the owner to let them stay and enjoy their chicken sandwich.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: The school is having a very special lantern parade, so each child gets to make their very own lantern with their face on. Oliver and Felicity are making theirs with help from Mrs Collins. They use a milk bottle for the body, pipe cleaners for arms and coloured paper for clothes, then they add a photo of their face. Once the lanterns have been made, the children hang them on a wire in the playground ready for the parade. Later when it is dark, their families and friends arrive to see a magical display of light!

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Doug's tooth has fallen out, so Jess and Simon tell Waffle about the Tooth Fairy. Waffle longs to meet the Tooth Fairy and his dream comes true.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: It's early in the morning, and Isabelle and Oona are off to visit Otto before he goes to bed. Pip and Pop are already fast asleep, but they've taken up all the bedding. Oona, Isabelle and Otto split up to find soft, comfy things for Otto to sleep on. Seagull feathers are the hardest to get, but Isabelle is the best flyer, so she's sure she can do it. However, her position as top flyer is challenged by Otto.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Sonny thinks he has found a box of broken junk, but it actually contains parts of something very special. Can Yukee and her friends put all the pieces back together again?

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie, Triggs, Mum and Dad are going for a walk in the countryside, but Dad is adamant that he does not want his pristine hiking shoes to get dirty. Luckily, Maddie and Triggs are on hand to stop their buddy getting muddy!

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Keith and Rebecca want to earn their camping badges. The Piggies set up the perfect site, but as night falls, strange noises echo through the forest... is it a monster? Their adventure is at risk until they realise it is just Wilf, and he is even more scared than them!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Learn how much fun counting can be with the Numberblocks - a fun-loving group of numbers who work together to solve problems big and small.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: Educational fun. Z has left the others in charge while he has a nap, but before long disaster strikes and Alphaland needs colouring in again.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Educational series using Makaton sign language. Mr Tumble invites Lord Tumble and Aunt Polly for tea. Meanwhile, Justin visits a Caribbean restaurant.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: As the Teletubbies say eh-oh to their reflections in a puddle, Dipsy's hat falls in and gets wet - oops! Dipsy sings a sad song, but then the sun shines and the wind blows, and his hat is dry again in no time! In Tummy Tales, the Teletubbies watch children enjoying their reflections in a Scottish loch.

programme.title: Andy's Prehistoric Adventures
programme.desc: Andy jumps into his time-travelling clock and heads back three million years, where he runs into some ancient primates and joins their tribe. Along the way, he helps them fend off a prehistoric big cat, before having his trusty backpack stolen by some hungry vultures.

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack’s stall. She chooses the ‘Save Swishy’ badge and remembers the day she got it… Ruby is worried about Swishy, a mermaid who lives in the bay. Lots of people are dropping plastic on the beach at Bridgetown, and she thinks it could make Swishy and her friends sick. When Daisy hears, she tells Ruby about protesting, and the two of them decide to go and protest on the beach in the hope that people will stop dropping litter. All the Hubbers pitch in, making ‘Save Swishy’ badges, hats, signs and Swishy biscuits. Daisy is delighted when Mack writes a special protest song to get the message out about reducing plastic pollution.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies’ very own motorcycle rider, Grace, shows off three amazing machines that are all used to help us in an emergency. Grace first heads to a mine in a mine rescue ambulance, then shows off the amazing fire boat and a huge incident command unit.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: It's class photo day, but no-one can work out why Biscuit has arrived with a box on her head. When the pups realise she is embarrassed about her 'fur' style, they work together to make her feel better by making paper hats for everyone to wear. Biscuit finally understands the importance of just being herself.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: Love Monster has to use all his willpower not to open Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny's present before night-time - but what can it be?

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: When a fire threatens a meerkat burrow, the Octonauts must put it out.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Lily's father decides to move the family out of the Lake District, Peter comes up with a clever but dangerous plan to change Dr Bobtail's mind.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: When Koa gets stung by a bee, Vida helps him get over his fear and make a new friend.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato invites Evil Pea to his sleepover, but Carrot is suspicious and vows to stay up all night to make sure she can't unleash any of her evil plans.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The Ducklings are building a train set and start bickering over who has the best idea. Weasy steps in to help, but his methods soon make things worse.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Nori and Preston are creating a circle of standing stones, just like the ancients of Swoppiton used to make. The stones are big - will it take more than Mojo’s crane top to move them?

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad’s accused of ‘fluffing’ in Bluey’s face, Mum calls a meeting to settle the matter

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: It is Bluey’s first trip to the cinema, but she’s worried that the movie will be too scary. When Bingo starts running amok in the theatre, she must conquer her fear and help Dad out.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: The doctors visit Fifi and see that she is feeling sad because her pies aren’t up to her usual standard. They take her out to cheer her up - until Zog realises what she really needs.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: Jen is monitoring some unusual earth tremors on Dino Island and uses a seismograph to research plate tectonics. Meanwhile, Andy is hungry and desperate to head to Dino Island for a practically perfect prehistoric picnic, so Jen asks him to get some seismic readings while he is out and about. Along the way, Andy meets some peckish Pachycephalosaurus, a hungry T. rex and a pterosaur.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: It's the hottest day of the year and Waffle is eating ice cream to cool down. Outside in the sweltering heat, Simon turns on the sprinkler to help everyone cool down, but poor Waffle doesn't like the sprinkler and darts through the hole in the fence to Mrs Hobbs's garden, looking for shade. The Brooklyn-Bells try to coax him back, but he refuses to return.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: At the playground, Khia won’t let Rafi and Ruby have a turn on the zip line. Rafi makes a wish for a magical new zip line that loops through the clouds and zooms around the park. At first, it’s amazing. But Rafi and Ruby ride again and again, forgetting the rule of one turn each. Soon, a long queue forms, and the friends realise they’re doing exactly what Khia did. Rafi decides it’s time to let others have a go. She realises that playground fun works best when everyone gets a turn.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo and her cousin Lexi are at the swimming pool with Gran Gran. It’s time for their swimming lesson with Reeni, and today they’re learning how to swim underwater. They remember it's breast stroke for arms and front crawl for legs, and they’re ready to go - but it turns out it’s a little bit tricky swimming underwater. It’s time for a Gran Gran plan and a little bit of practice with some sinkers. But who can help Panda when he decides to take a jump in the pool too?

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Scooter Boy gets his confidence knocked after a small accident, so Sarah and Duck help him to get it back.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: It is very hot in Mother's garden, and all her flowers are wilting. Major has invented an auto-waterer to help but it doesn't work. Tiny comes up with a brilliant idea for watering the garden based on a marble-chute toy she has invented.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa chase a butterfly, and MeMo is gentle when it lands on their hand. At the Play Tree, they play with a bubble blower. MeMo blows a big bubble, but BaBa forgets to be gentle and pops it. The Yummies and MeMo teach BaBa to be gentle when petting Yummy Dog and handling some ripe strawberries. On the Lullaby Lake, BaBa is very gentle when the butterfly returns to settle on their hand.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures and are read bedtime stories. Igglepiggle and Upsy Daisy go for a very long walk. Feeling tired, they decide to return by Ninky Nonk - and have a very bouncy ride.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: Tom Holland tells the classic tale of Superworm. Even superheroes need a little help sometimes, but can Superworm's friends save the day?

programme.desc: The Twirlywoos watch a waiter set a wedding table in a marquee. The waiter places plates and cutlery next to each other. The Twirlywoos then decide to help out by getting items from outside and placing them next to the plates until there is an entire garden's worth of items on the table. The bride and groom enter and are amazed. Peekaboo has trouble with the Twirly Rings rolling around the Big Red Boat. When the Twirlywoos arrive, they jump down into the Big Red Boat, only to land next to each other inside the Twirly Rings!

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and his friend take a boat trip to spot some wildlife. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble creates a beach in his garden, but things don’t entirely go to plan.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Preschool series. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po do a roundy round dance and watch children in Tummy Tales ride a carousel which goes round and round too.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Nigel and Baby Bear welcome babies Amber, Amelia, Arthur, DJ, Zadie, Betsy, Indianna and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Inside everyone’s bags in this episode are Leaves which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding baby appropriate leaves inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The song ‘All the leaves are falling down’ features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Action Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children craft hanging stars from twigs and colourful string, learn British Sign Language signs for twinkle, star and world, then sing and sign Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star.

programme.title: I Can Grow It
programme.desc: Aaron, Nelly and Abbie follow Chatterpot’s slimy trail to discover how slugs and snails love to munch around in the garden and help keep the garden tidy and magical.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Bahati the zebra has an itch she just can’t scratch, so her friends try to help. Hamza discovers wild buffalo and visits some thirsty elephants.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Kiri decides to make Lou miss her, but it doesn’t go well.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In a game of 'Work', Dad hires Bluey and Bingo at his drainpipe factory. But when Bluey takes charge, Dad finds his new boss pretty tough, especially her no dancing rule.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: When Egg, the cheeky little chick, goes on the run again, Duggee whistles to get him back. Hang on a minute Duggee, what was that noise? A whistle? The Squirrels want to learn how to whistle.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: The Printing Crew come to the rescue and print signs for their friends Red, Blue and Green.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: George wants to find out all about prawns in today’s episode. Chantelle meets some new friends at the beach and heads to the rock pools to search for prawns, whilst Rory goes to the north of Scotland to meet a local expert at the harbour. Chantelle and Rory’s fact files help answer all of George’s questions. With the help of the Teeny Tiny Creatures poem, we discover that, like lots of other teeny tiny creatures, prawns are superheroes and help our planet in their own special way. In the Teeny Tiny Task, Chantelle and the children play at being prawns with a game of 'What’s the Time, Mr Fish?'

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Today, sisters Iona and Elba make their family’s famous shortbread biscuits and throw a picnic with teddy bears! Out in the park, they play at launching rockets into the sky. But when one of the rockets lands in a stream, will the brave astronauts be able to get it back?

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Children’s cookery series with Big Cook Jen and Little Cook Small. Jen is being an artist today and trying to paint a cheetah, but she has run out of paint for the spots. They are visited by Ada the Artist and cook her a delicious arty pancake.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Tinks is a disability assistance dog for her owner Charli, who has a condition that makes it painful for her to pick things up or to push and pull things. Tinks uses her super fetch skills to help Charli every day. The smallest of the Dog Squad gang, Tinks is a little Lhasa apso with lots of big dog energy. Charli is meeting her friend Annabel for lunch at the local café. They haven’t been out for a lunch treat for ages, and the café’s speciality is Tinks’s favourite – chicken. First, Charli parks her car using her blue parking badge and then gets her wheelchair out of the boot using a hoist. Tinks then helps Charli go into the café, find a table and go to the counter to order their lunch. But when the café owner sees Tinks, he tells Charli that they only allow in guide dogs and that Tinks will have to wait outside. Brave Tinks summons all her big dog energy to help Charli persuade the owner to let them stay and enjoy their chicken sandwich.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: The school is having a very special lantern parade, so each child gets to make their very own lantern with their face on. Oliver and Felicity are making theirs with help from Mrs Collins. They use a milk bottle for the body, pipe cleaners for arms and coloured paper for clothes, then they add a photo of their face. Once the lanterns have been made, the children hang them on a wire in the playground ready for the parade. Later when it is dark, their families and friends arrive to see a magical display of light!

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Doug's tooth has fallen out, so Jess and Simon tell Waffle about the Tooth Fairy. Waffle longs to meet the Tooth Fairy and his dream comes true.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: It's early in the morning, and Isabelle and Oona are off to visit Otto before he goes to bed. Pip and Pop are already fast asleep, but they've taken up all the bedding. Oona, Isabelle and Otto split up to find soft, comfy things for Otto to sleep on. Seagull feathers are the hardest to get, but Isabelle is the best flyer, so she's sure she can do it. However, her position as top flyer is challenged by Otto.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Sonny thinks he has found a box of broken junk, but it actually contains parts of something very special. Can Yukee and her friends put all the pieces back together again?

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie, Triggs, Mum and Dad are going for a walk in the countryside, but Dad is adamant that he does not want his pristine hiking shoes to get dirty. Luckily, Maddie and Triggs are on hand to stop their buddy getting muddy!

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Keith and Rebecca want to earn their camping badges. The Piggies set up the perfect site, but as night falls, strange noises echo through the forest... is it a monster? Their adventure is at risk until they realise it is just Wilf, and he is even more scared than them!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Learn how much fun counting can be with the Numberblocks - a fun-loving group of numbers who work together to solve problems big and small.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: Educational fun. Z has left the others in charge while he has a nap, but before long disaster strikes and Alphaland needs colouring in again.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Educational series using Makaton sign language. Mr Tumble invites Lord Tumble and Aunt Polly for tea. Meanwhile, Justin visits a Caribbean restaurant.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: As the Teletubbies say eh-oh to their reflections in a puddle, Dipsy's hat falls in and gets wet - oops! Dipsy sings a sad song, but then the sun shines and the wind blows, and his hat is dry again in no time! In Tummy Tales, the Teletubbies watch children enjoying their reflections in a Scottish loch.

programme.title: Andy's Prehistoric Adventures
programme.desc: Andy jumps into his time-travelling clock and heads back three million years, where he runs into some ancient primates and joins their tribe. Along the way, he helps them fend off a prehistoric big cat, before having his trusty backpack stolen by some hungry vultures.

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack’s stall. She chooses the ‘Save Swishy’ badge and remembers the day she got it… Ruby is worried about Swishy, a mermaid who lives in the bay. Lots of people are dropping plastic on the beach at Bridgetown, and she thinks it could make Swishy and her friends sick. When Daisy hears, she tells Ruby about protesting, and the two of them decide to go and protest on the beach in the hope that people will stop dropping litter. All the Hubbers pitch in, making ‘Save Swishy’ badges, hats, signs and Swishy biscuits. Daisy is delighted when Mack writes a special protest song to get the message out about reducing plastic pollution.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies’ very own motorcycle rider, Grace, shows off three amazing machines that are all used to help us in an emergency. Grace first heads to a mine in a mine rescue ambulance, then shows off the amazing fire boat and a huge incident command unit.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: It's class photo day, but no-one can work out why Biscuit has arrived with a box on her head. When the pups realise she is embarrassed about her 'fur' style, they work together to make her feel better by making paper hats for everyone to wear. Biscuit finally understands the importance of just being herself.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: Love Monster has to use all his willpower not to open Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny's present before night-time - but what can it be?

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: When a fire threatens a meerkat burrow, the Octonauts must put it out.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Lily's father decides to move the family out of the Lake District, Peter comes up with a clever but dangerous plan to change Dr Bobtail's mind.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: When Koa gets stung by a bee, Vida helps him get over his fear and make a new friend.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato invites Evil Pea to his sleepover, but Carrot is suspicious and vows to stay up all night to make sure she can't unleash any of her evil plans.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The Ducklings are building a train set and start bickering over who has the best idea. Weasy steps in to help, but his methods soon make things worse.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Nori and Preston are creating a circle of standing stones, just like the ancients of Swoppiton used to make. The stones are big - will it take more than Mojo’s crane top to move them?

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad’s accused of ‘fluffing’ in Bluey’s face, Mum calls a meeting to settle the matter

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: It is Bluey’s first trip to the cinema, but she’s worried that the movie will be too scary. When Bingo starts running amok in the theatre, she must conquer her fear and help Dad out.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: The doctors visit Fifi and see that she is feeling sad because her pies aren’t up to her usual standard. They take her out to cheer her up - until Zog realises what she really needs.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: Jen is monitoring some unusual earth tremors on Dino Island and uses a seismograph to research plate tectonics. Meanwhile, Andy is hungry and desperate to head to Dino Island for a practically perfect prehistoric picnic, so Jen asks him to get some seismic readings while he is out and about. Along the way, Andy meets some peckish Pachycephalosaurus, a hungry T. rex and a pterosaur.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: It's the hottest day of the year and Waffle is eating ice cream to cool down. Outside in the sweltering heat, Simon turns on the sprinkler to help everyone cool down, but poor Waffle doesn't like the sprinkler and darts through the hole in the fence to Mrs Hobbs's garden, looking for shade. The Brooklyn-Bells try to coax him back, but he refuses to return.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: At the playground, Khia won’t let Rafi and Ruby have a turn on the zip line. Rafi makes a wish for a magical new zip line that loops through the clouds and zooms around the park. At first, it’s amazing. But Rafi and Ruby ride again and again, forgetting the rule of one turn each. Soon, a long queue forms, and the friends realise they’re doing exactly what Khia did. Rafi decides it’s time to let others have a go. She realises that playground fun works best when everyone gets a turn.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo and her cousin Lexi are at the swimming pool with Gran Gran. It’s time for their swimming lesson with Reeni, and today they’re learning how to swim underwater. They remember it's breast stroke for arms and front crawl for legs, and they’re ready to go - but it turns out it’s a little bit tricky swimming underwater. It’s time for a Gran Gran plan and a little bit of practice with some sinkers. But who can help Panda when he decides to take a jump in the pool too?

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Scooter Boy gets his confidence knocked after a small accident, so Sarah and Duck help him to get it back.

programme.title: Clangers

programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa chase a butterfly, and MeMo is gentle when it lands on their hand. At the Play Tree, they play with a bubble blower. Omar is finally removed, but relief is short-lived as the group realises a potentially more dangerous liar remains. With nerves fraying, the focus shifts to hunting the key. Ella, Jackie and John tank in the quiz, while a playful garden party game further exposes Jackie and Ella's gaps in popular culture to the group. With pressure mounting, one player's guilt takes over, leading to an emotional decision to leave the game on their own terms. The house regroups, but trust is thin. A secret advantage is won, and when its existence becomes clear, is Billy about to be exposed?
